title: Batman Begins — Why do we fall?

hook.quote: Why do we fall? So we can learn to pick ourselves up.
hook.context: Kichkina Bruce quduqqa yiqilganda otasi undan shunday so'raydi: "Nega yiqilamiz? O'rnimizdan turishni o'rganish uchun." Keyinchalik bu gapni sodiq xizmatkor Alfred unga eslatadi. "Why do we...?" — do yordamchi fe'li bilan savol.

reading: Bruce Wayne grows up in a rich family in Gotham City. When he is a child, he falls into an old well full of bats, and he becomes terrified of them.
One night, after a visit to the opera, a criminal shoots his parents in front of him. Bruce feels guilty and angry for years.
As a young man he travels around the world to understand how criminals think. He lives on the streets, steals food and ends up in prison in Asia.
A mysterious man, Ducard, invites him to join a secret group, the League of Shadows. Bruce learns to fight and to control his fear.
But when the League asks him to kill a man, Bruce refuses. He wants justice, not revenge. He escapes and returns to Gotham.
With the help of his butler Alfred and a scientist, Lucius Fox, he creates a new identity. He chooses the bat, the thing he was afraid of, as his symbol.
"You're not going to give up, are you?" Alfred asks when things go badly. Bruce isn't. He has learned that falling is not the end. It is a chance to rise.

grammar.title: Savol shakllari va tag questions
explain: Savolda yordamchi fe'l egadan OLDIN: **Why do** we fall? **Where did** he go? **Have** you **seen** it? Present/Past Simple'da **do/does/did** kerak ("Why we fall?" — xato).
**Subject questions** — kim/nima EGA bo'lsa, do ishlatilmaydi: **Who saved** Bruce? (Who did save — xato). Lekin **Who did** Bruce **save**? — Bruce ega.
**Tag questions** — gap oxiridagi qisqa "shundaymi?": ijobiy gap → inkor tag: You're tired, **aren't you**? Inkor gap → ijobiy tag: You're not going to give up, **are you**?
Tag yordamchi fe'lni takrorlaydi: He **can** fight, **can't** he? She **lives** here, **doesn't** she? They **went**, **didn't** they? Maxsus: I am → **aren't I**? Let's → **shall we**?

exercises.why: Present Simple savol: do + ega + fe'l.
